headerDisplay:
Connects Honeywell/Resideo Evohome to Apple HomeKit. Use the credentials from https://getconnected.honeywellhome.com.

**Upgrading from 0.11.x:** Your devices get new identifiers once and will therefore appear in the default room. You need to move them back and recreate scenes and automations. After that the assignment stays put — the long-standing problem of accessories disappearing for no obvious reason is fixed.

The `childBridge` and `temperatureUnit` options no longer exist and can be removed from your configuration.
footerDisplay: Add one entry per home (location) in your Honeywell account. Questions and bug reports: https://github.com/luc-ass/homebridge-evohome

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Homebridge log and used as the prefix for the system mode switches.

locationId.title: Location ID
locationId.description: Only needed if your account holds more than one home. The ID is printed in the log at startup and is stable — unlike the index. Leave empty to use the index instead.

locationIndex.title: Location index
locationIndex.description: Fallback when no location ID is set. Starts at 0. Note that the index shifts if a home is added to your Honeywell account.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the status is fetched from Honeywell. Shorter intervals run into Honeywell's rate limit; anything below 60 seconds is raised to 60.

setpointMode.title: How long a temperature change applies
setpointMode.description: Controls how long a temperature set from HomeKit stays in effect. "Keep the existing end time": if a temporary override is already running, its end time is preserved and only the temperature changes — otherwise the change applies until the next switchpoint. "Until the next switchpoint" matches the behaviour of 0.11.2 and earlier. "Permanent" overrides the schedule until you pick "Auto" in HomeKit. Turning a thermostat off is always permanent, regardless of this setting.

temperatureAboveAsOff.title: Show a zone as off when the room is warmer than the target
temperatureAboveAsOff.description: Purely cosmetic: changes the display in HomeKit, not the heating itself.

logTemperatureChanges.title: Log room temperature changes
logTemperatureChanges.description: Writes a line to the log whenever a room temperature changed. Useful for working out after the fact why it was cold in the morning.

history.title: Record history for the Eve app
history.description: Records temperature and valve position for the Elgato Eve app using fakegato-history. Turn this off if you do not need the graphs, or if that package causes trouble at startup — it is then never loaded at all.
